show.description: When the system shatters lives, some cry — others swear to break it. Boss Revenge Squad follows four wronged people — a fallen businessman, a genius hacker, an ex-cop and a street-smart hustler — who band together to take down ruthless bosses who exploit and destroy their employees. Calculated plans, brutal payback and a corporate war where every secret becomes a weapon. This isn’t just revenge — it’s corporate warfare.
